entry.title: A familiar thing and its picture
entry.summary: Name a few familiar objects together. If matching interests your child, offer a picture that looks just like the object.
entry.cue: Notice interest in naming things, recognizing pictures, or finding a familiar object in a book.
detail: Davies groups vocabulary objects around a familiar theme. A photograph of the actual object can make the match clear; a similar but different picture is a later challenge once identical matching is familiar.

Say the names and enjoy finding a match. If an object lands on a different picture, notice it without turning the moment into a test, and return to naming another time. The book reserves its formal naming test for children over 3.
Picture cards on a familiar theme can also extend the words you share. Stay with your child when using small real or replica objects; the book’s small-part supervision condition still applies.

ageContext.bookAge: Vocabulary objects:12+ months; matching objects with cards:14+ months. The separate vocabulary-card row says 18+ months.
ageContext.readiness: Start with naming and exploring objects; matching follows interest, and similar pictures follow identical matches.
ageContext.note: Picture cards without matching objects are a later vocabulary example. Formal naming tests are for children over 3 in this book. Age and readiness sources: The Montessori Toddler, PDF pp. 14.

displayContext.footer: You don’t need a different home. Start with what you have.
displayContext.colophon: Original summaries inspired by The Montessori Baby and The Montessori Toddler. Open any idea for its book references. The illustration is an invitation to explore, rather than a room to reproduce. Follow your child’s pace.
